color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim from hermes — no modification. Warm cream page background (#fcf7f1, luminance 247.8) satisfies color_register=light.

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B (letter-spacing injection) at intensity 2: added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.04em to all heading sizes, button, and nav. Replaced proprietary fonts (meno-banner → Playfair Display, commuters-sans → Raleway, proxima-nova → Open Sans, Helvetica → Raleway) with Google Fonts CDN imports. All woff2 references removed.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A (duration scaling slower) at intensity 2: all numeric animation durations multiplied by 1.3×. Base transitions: 0.4s→0.52s, fast: 0.2s→0.26s, slow: 0.5s→0.65s, badge rotation: 4s→5.2s.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A (container max-width tightened) at intensity 2: reduced container maxWidth from 1280px to 1120px (−12.5%). Produces a more editorial, narrower column measure that slows reading pace.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist A (global scale factor compress) at intensity 3: all numeric spacing values multiplied by 0.75×. Produces tighter rhythm without crowding — components sit closer, creating continuous narrative flow over spacious breathing room.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A (hover transition speed more languid) at intensity 3: all hover transition durations increased by +0.15s (0.4s→0.55s). No color values changed. Applied consistently to buttons, inputs, links, and navigation.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist A (nav height taller) at intensity 3: height increased from 30px to 46px (+16px). Additionally applied Twist D (letter spacing) at intensity 3: added letterSpacing: 0.08em to nav typography. No color values changed.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C (Material shift): rewrote Section 4 paragraph 2 to describe the tactile quality of the warm cream background — evoking aged broadsheet stock, the yellow-ivory tint of handled newsprint, a surface that has absorbed time and light. Also generated concept_by_video.md with 3 video placements: hero-bg.mp4 (10s slow drift), feature-ambient.mp4 (10s deliberate product interaction), services-ambient.mp4 (5s macro material surface).
